## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Layers respected (`router → service → repository → model`)
- [ ] Tests added for solver constraints, service invariants or the fixed bug
- [ ] `make gen-api` run if the API changed
- [ ] New user-facing text added to `frontend/src/locales/es.json`
- [ ] Migration included and reviewed if the schema changed
- [ ] ADR added under `docs/adr/` if this constrains future work
